I am young, only 26, but I have learned from my father how to grow maize here in Balaka. My main maize plot is small, only 0.08 hectares, so I must use it well because my family depends on it for nsima. If I get the FISP coupon this year I will buy NPK and urea, otherwise I can only afford a little fertilizer from the market. I keep some chickens and goats, so I will spread their manure on the plot before the rains, and I intercrop with pigeon pea to help the soil and give us relish.
